subject.title: fix(proxy): add error handler on upstream response stream

question: Should maintainers require a refreshed or ported branch before merge so the upstream response error handler lands without dropping current main's proxy capture behavior?
rationale: The fix shape is sound, but GitHub reports the PR dirty and current main changed the same proxy capture files, so a human-owned conflict resolution choice is needed before merge.

options.title: Refresh preserving current capture behavior
options.body: Port the handler and regression test onto current main, keeping body-preview capture and shared-state test setup intact.

options.title: Pause for author refresh
options.body: Leave the PR open until the contributor refreshes the branch and ClawSweeper can review the exact mergeable head.

options.title: Replace with a narrow maintainer patch
options.body: If the external branch stays unmergeable, land the same narrow fix through a replacement PR and close this PR after the replacement exists.

recommendation.title: Refresh preserving current capture behavior
recommendation.body: Port the handler and regression test onto current main, keeping body-preview capture and shared-state test setup intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to steipete, and he merged the related debug-proxy socket repair.
